story.speaker: uncle_t
story.title: THE BARBER'S FAVOUR
story.scene: Shop shuts at eight. He wants you there at ten past, on your own. It's the start of something bigger than a haircut.

story.speaker: nads
story.title: THE PLUG
story.scene: Two tickets north and a napkin with two columns on it. She's decided you're going. You get to decide who you are when you get there.

story.speaker: silas
story.title: YOUR OWN LINE
story.scene: A members' bar with no members. Silas Rhodes wants to hand you the keys to nine cities — and tell you what they cost.

contracts.speaker: nads
contracts.title: CLEAR THE YARD VAN
contracts.scene: Bow. Transit full of copper, gate code good until midnight.

contracts.speaker: delroy
contracts.title: TWO KEEPERS, NO QUESTIONS
contracts.scene: Anything German, anything after 2019. Bring it to the arches.
